name: update_basket_line
description: Change one basket line: the amount, the unit, the delivery date, or offer_id to choose one of the line's alternatives. 0 and empty strings keep a value. The gateway prices the line again: read message_for_user and never state a number that is not in this result. Then call show_basket.

basket_id.description: basket_id exactly as a basket tool returned it. Never invent or edit it.

line_id.description: line_id exactly as a basket tool returned it.

amount.description: New amount for the whole line, as a number. 0 keeps the amount. Default: 0.

unit.description: New unit of the amount: L, KG or PCS. Empty keeps the unit. Default: "".

need_date.description: New delivery date, YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Helsinki). Empty keeps the date. Default: "".

offer_id.description: offer_id of one of this line's alternatives, exactly as returned. Empty keeps the offer. Default: "".
